missedFeedback.body:
The experience illustrated here, where accounts are created and logged into from settings, is unintuitive and unfamiliar. On mobile, we should instead present with the option to log in or create an account when the app is launched, or offer the opportunity to continue without creating an account.

Thereafter, it should be possible to access account creation/login, or sign out of a logged-in account from settings, but this should generally link the user back to the account register/login page instead of just being an inline form.
